zh.intro: DeepSeek Gestalt 0.1.3 收录上一版本之后的 {{commitCount}} 个提交。

sections.heading: 模型与子代理
items: 新启动的子代理继承主会话当前的 provider 和 model，而不是创建会话时的路由。
continuable 子会话在运行时与主会话一样，主按钮切成停止，不再并排发送。

en.intro: DeepSeek Gestalt 0.1.3 contains the {{commitCount}} commits after the previous Desktop Bundle.

sections.heading: Models and subagents
items: A newly started subagent inherits the parent session's current provider and model, not the route from session creation.
A running continuable child uses the same primary Stop toggle as an ordinary session instead of pairing Send beside Stop.
